title: Geotechnical Report
description: A geotechnical engineering investigation report, as used by structural engineers, contractors, plan reviewers and lenders: the project and site, the subsurface conditions logged at each test boring, and the laboratory consolidation test results.

report.description: Who prepared the report, for which project, and when.

report_title.description: Title of the report as printed on the cover, e.g. 'Geotechnical Engineering Investigation'.

project_name.description: Name of the proposed project the investigation was performed for.

project_number.description: The consultant's project or job number.

site_address.description: Street address and city of the investigated site.

client.description: The organization the report was prepared for.

consultant.description: The geotechnical engineering firm that prepared the report.

report_date.description: Date of the report as printed on the cover.

borings.description: One entry per test boring log. A log that continues over several pages is a single boring.

boring_id.description: Boring designation from the log heading, e.g. 'B-1'.

date_drilled.description: Date the boring was drilled, as printed in the log header.

drill_rig.description: Drill rig model from the 'Drill Type' header field.

auger_type.description: Auger or drilling method from the 'Auger Type' header field.

hammer_type.description: Sampler hammer from the 'Hammer Type' header field, e.g. '140 Pound Auto Trip'.

surface_elevation_ft.description: Ground surface elevation at the boring in feet, from the 'Elevation' header field.

groundwater_first_encountered_ft.description: Depth in feet at which groundwater was first encountered during drilling, from the log header. Null if not encountered.

groundwater_after_drilling_ft.description: Depth in feet at which groundwater was measured after drilling, from the log notes. Null if not reported.

total_depth_ft.description: Depth in feet at which the boring was terminated, from the 'Bottom of Boring' note.

termination_reason.description: Why the boring was terminated, if the log says.

samples.description: Each sampled interval on the log that has an N-value, in order of increasing depth.

uscs.description: USCS soil classification symbol of the stratum the sample is in, e.g. 'SM' or 'SP-SM'.

soil_description.description: The soil description beside the sample, starting with the soil name in capitals where one is given.

n_value_blows_per_ft.description: N-value in blows per foot from the 'N-Values' column.

moisture_content_pct.description: Moisture content in percent from the 'Moisture Content %' column on the same row as the N-value.

lab_remarks.description: Laboratory results in the 'Remarks' column beside this sample, verbatim (e.g. 'DD = 95.0 pcf'), or null if none.

consolidation_tests.description: One entry per consolidation test report page.

sample_no.description: Sample number, which names the boring, e.g. 'B-1'.

depth.description: Sample elevation or depth range as printed, e.g. "2-3.5'".

material_description.description: Material description of the tested sample.

uscs.description: USCS classification of the tested sample.

natural_saturation_pct.description: Natural degree of saturation in percent ('Natural Sat.').

natural_moisture_pct.description: Natural moisture content in percent ('Natural Moist.').

dry_density_pcf.description: Dry density in pounds per cubic foot.

specific_gravity.description: Specific gravity of soil solids ('Sp. Gr.').
